title: hypochaeris acaulis
intro: Hypochaeris acaulis, commonly known as rough cat's ear, is a perennial plant species in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, providing health benefits such as wound healing, reduction of fever, and relief from digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hypochaeris acaulis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids. These constituents contribute to the plant's overall therapeutic potential, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
